editorial.blurb: Sushi Loop delivers exceptional quality and generous portions at all-you-can-eat prices, with a warm atmosphere and service that makes you feel genuinely welcomed.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation ahead of time, and don't over-order—the rolls are generously sized and the quality rivals high-end spots, so a little goes a long way.

topDishes.note: Reviewers rave about this signature roll with genuine enthusiasm
Fresh and flavorful, especially the salmon and scallops
